betweenImportsLevel.markdownDescription:
restrict betweenImports setting to a specific level
"all" - apply betweenImports to all imports/using entries
"firstLevelPackage" - group imports/using entries using toplevel package names; no empty lines for identical toplevel names
"secondLevelPackage" - group imports/using entries using top- and secondlevel package names; no empty lines for identical toplevel and secondlevel names
"thirdLevelPackage" - group imports/using entries using upto thirdlevel package names
"fourthLevelPackage" - group imports/using entries using upto foruthlevel package names
"fifthLevelPackage" - group imports/using entries using upto fifthlevel package names
"fullPackage" - group imports/using entries using full packages; no empty lines for identical package names

betweenImports.markdownDescription: empty lines between two consecutive import/using lines using betweenImportsLevel

beforeUsing.markdownDescription: empty lines between import and using lines

beforeType.markdownDescription: empty lines after import and using section

lineCommentsBetweenFunctions.markdownDescription: empty lines for line comments between functions

betweenMultilineComments.markdownDescription: Adds empty lines between two consecutive multiline comments

afterLeftCurly.markdownDescription: Remove or keep empty lines below "{"

lineCommentsBetweenTypes.markdownDescription: empty lines for line comments between types

betweenSingleLineTypes.markdownDescription: empty lines between two single line types

afterFileHeaderComment.markdownDescription: Adds empty lines when file starts with a multiline comment

beforeDocCommentEmptyLines.markdownDescription:
"one" adds one empty line above doc comments
"none" removes all empty lines above doc comments
"ignore" respects empty lines set via "betweenVars", "betweenFunctions", etc.

afterReturn.markdownDescription: Remove or keep empty lines below "return"

beforeRightCurly.markdownDescription: Remove or keep empty lines above "}"

maxAnywhereInFile.markdownDescription: maximum consecutive empty lines anywhere in file - runs last, all empty lines policies are limited to "maxAnywhereInFile"

importAndUsing.markdownDescription: empty lines for package, import and using section

afterFieldsWithDocComments.markdownDescription:
"one" adds one empty line after fields with doc comments
"none" removes all empty lines line fields with doc comments
"ignore" respects empty lines set via "betweenVars", "betweenFunctions", etc.

endType.markdownDescription: add empty lines before closing "}" of type

beginType.markdownDescription: add empty lines after opening "{" of type

compressSuccessiveParenthesis.markdownDescription: should formatter compress spaces for successive parenthesis `( [ {` vs. `([{`

formatStringInterpolation.markdownDescription:
should formatter try to format string interpolation expressions (e.g. '${x+3}' -> '${x + 3}')
only applies spaces, no newlines or wrapping

excludes.markdownDescription:
regular expressions matching files to exclude from formatting
default is to exclude any `.haxelib`, `.git` and `node_modules` folder

disableFormatting.markdownDescription:
turns off formatting for all files in current folder and subfolders
unless subfolder contains a `hxformat.json`

beginType.markdownDescription: add empty lines after opening "{" of type

endType.markdownDescription: add empty lines before closing "}" of type

location.markdownDescription: default wrapping location before / after last token

conditions.markdownDescription:
list of conditions
wrapping selects a rule if all of its conditions evaluate to true

additionalIndent.markdownDescription: adds indentation to all wrapped lines

anonFuncParamParens.markdownDescription: parens used for anon function parameters

rules.markdownDescription:
list of wrapping rules
wrapping uses only the first rule whose conditions evaluates to true

defaultWrap.markdownDescription: default wrapping type when no rule applies

defaultLocation.markdownDescription: default wrapping location before / after last token

defaultAdditionalIndent.markdownDescription: adds indentation to all wrapped lines when applying defaultWrap

beginType.markdownDescription: add empty lines after opening "{" of type

endType.markdownDescription: add empty lines before closing "}" of type

anonTypeCurly.markdownDescription: line end settings for anon type curlies

objectLiteralCurly.markdownDescription: line end settings for object literal curlies

leftCurly.markdownDescription: global left curly line end setting

blockCurly.markdownDescription: line end settings for block curlies

anonFunctionCurly.markdownDescription: line end settings for anon function body curlies

emptyCurly.markdownDescription: global empty curlies line end setting

rightCurly.markdownDescription: global right curly line end setting

typedefCurly.markdownDescription: line end settings for typedef curlies

rightCurly.markdownDescription: line end options for right curly

leftCurly.markdownDescription: line end options for left curly

emptyCurly.markdownDescription: line end options for empty curlies

functionBody.markdownDescription:
same line policy for non block body of "function"
* same = place function and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

ifBody.markdownDescription:
same line policy for non block body of "if"
* same = place if and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

anonFunctionBody.markdownDescription:
same line policy for non block body of anon "function"
* same = place function and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

catchBody.markdownDescription:
same line policy for non block body of "catch"
* same = place catch and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

tryCatch.markdownDescription:
same line policy for "catch" part of "try…catch"
* same = place function and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

untypedBody.markdownDescription:
same line policy for untyped {…} as a body
* same = place return and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

returnBodySingleLine.markdownDescription:
same line policy for single line expression return values
* same = place return and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

elseIf.markdownDescription:
same line policy for "if" part of "else if"
* same = place if and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

returnBody.markdownDescription:
same line policy for multiline expression return values
* same = place return and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

expressionIf.markdownDescription:
same line policy for non block body of "if" in a value place / as expression
* same = place if and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

doWhile.markdownDescription:
same line policy for "while" part in "do…while"
* same = place while and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

whileBody.markdownDescription:
same line policy for non block body of "while" (not "do…while")
* same = place while and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

ifElse.markdownDescription:
same line policy for "else" part of "if…else"
* same = place else and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

doWhileBody.markdownDescription:
same line policy for non block body of "do…while"
* same = place function and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

expressionIfWithBlocks.markdownDescription:
will place if with one expression in a block in one line (requires "expressionIf" = "same")
var foo = if (bar) { ""; } else { ""; };

elseBody.markdownDescription:
same line policy for non block body of "else"
* same = place else and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

tryBody.markdownDescription:
same line policy for non block body of "try"
* same = place try and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

forBody.markdownDescription:
same line policy for non block body of "for"
* same = place function and body on same line
* next = place body on next line
* keep = keep same / next line from source

multiVar.markdownDescription: chain wrapping rules for OpAdd / OpSub

maxLineLength.markdownDescription: maximum characters per line, formatter will try to wrap code longer than `maxLineLength`

arrayMatrixWrap.markdownDescription:
detect arrays in matrix configuration from source
noMatrixWrap = no detection
matrixWrapNoAlign = detect and format as matrix without alignment
matrixWrapWithAlign = detect and format as matrix and align columns

opAddSubChain.markdownDescription: chain wrapping rules for OpAdd / OpSub

arrayWrap.markdownDescription:
array wrapping rules
does not affect array comprehension, use "sameLine.comprehensionFor"

casePattern.markdownDescription: chain wrapping rules for case patterns

markdownEnumDescriptions: every item in a separate line, including first item
every item in a separate line, except first item
put an equal amount of items per line - not yet implemented
fill each line until maxLineLength - does not start with a newline
fill each line until maxLineLength, starts with a newline before first item

beginType.markdownDescription: add empty lines after opening "{" of type

endType.markdownDescription: add empty lines before closing "}" of type

markdownEnumDescriptions: condition matches if item count is larger than or equal n characters
condition matches if item count is less than or equal n characters
condition matches if max item length is larger than or equal n characters
condition matches if max item length is less than or equal n characters
condition matches if total length of all wrapable items is larger than or equal n characters
condition matches if total length of all wrapable items is less than or equal n characters
condition matches lines larger than or equal n characters
condition matches lines less than or equal n characters

condition value = 1 matches if line contains a multiline token (string literal, block comment)
value = 0 matches if no multiline token is present

condition value = 1 matches if unwrapped line exceeds maxLineLength
value = 0 matches unwrapped lines not exceeding maxLineLength

indentCaseLabels.markdownDescription: indent case / default labels (true) or keep them on same level as switch (false)

trailingWhitespace.markdownDescription: adds trailing whitespace to empty lines by copying indentation from preceeding line

character.markdownDescription: use "tab", " ", "  ", "   ", "    ", etc. to define which character to use

tabWidth.markdownDescription: if `character` is set to "tab", formatter uses `tabWidth` to calculate absolute line length

conditionalPolicy.markdownDescription:
only applies to non inlined conditionals
"fixedZero" = all conditional statements should start in column 1
"fixedZeroIncrease" = indentation for conditionals starts at 0 and increases for every level
"fixedZeroIncreaseBlocks" = same as "fixedZeroIncrease" but increases only inside blocks, outside it's "fixedZero"
"aligned" = conditional statements share indentation of surrounding code
"alignedNestedIncrease" = conditionals align with surrounding code, but will increase indent when nested
"alignedIncrease" = same as "aligned" but will increase indent by +1 for enclosed code
"alignedDecrease" = same as "aligned" but will decrease indent by -1 for enclosed code
